title: The World Cup’s final four is set. Here’s what you need to know before the final week
facts: England and Argentina advanced to the semi-finals of the 2026 World Cup by eliminating Norway and Switzerland.
Jude Bellingham scored two goals for England in their quarter-final victory over Norway.
Julián Alvarez scored a goal in extra time to secure Argentina's quarter-final win over Switzerland.
Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham have both scored six goals for England during the 2026 World Cup tournament.
Argentina has scored 17 total goals in the 2026 World Cup tournament, more than any other competing nation.
Didier Deschamps will conclude his tenure as the manager of the France national team following the 2026 World Cup.
Spain defeated France in the semi-finals of Euro 2024 and in the UEFA Nations League in 2025.
The Spanish national team conceded only one goal across the tournament prior to the semi-final against France.
Switzerland forward Breel Embolo was sent off in the quarter-final against Argentina after receiving a second yellow card via VAR review.
South Africa international midfielder Jayden Adams died at the age of 25 shortly after playing in three World Cup matches.
The round-of-16 match between the United States and Belgium was viewed by 46 million total viewers in the United States.
Belgium defeated the United States Men's National Team 4-1 in the round of 16.
FOX network's English-language broadcast of the USA versus Belgium match averaged 33.1 million viewers.
Telemundo's Spanish-language broadcast of the USA versus Belgium match reached an audience of 12.9 million viewers.
England manager Thomas Tuchel publicly criticized his team's technical quality and passing execution following the win against Norway.
